name: 30309 · Atlanta, GA
findings: ZIP 30309 (Atlanta) has 396 nonprofit organizations. 164 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 134 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (12% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30309 (Atlanta) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
34% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 30309 (Atlanta) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 134 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.
